EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: WLP/LAN/4/ACQ/14. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/289.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. .
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot Nos. 01—28 (28 Lots) allotments in total extent of about 0.2745 Hectare of land in Preliminary Plan No. 2676 dated 22.07.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of Welipitiya, Watagedaramulla, Palalla in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Welipitiya in Matara District in the Southern Province.
